objective: Quantify mesh uncertainty for lightweight M09; refined grids are reference levels for future coarsening.

restarts.new_grids: Higher-order stencil mapping of the same saved M09 solution at t=2.04 s, no cold initialization.

CFL_policy.interpretation: Project accuracy screening limits for implicit URANS, not a universal explicit CFL stability bound or a quoted Fluid Mechanics 101 numeric limit. Verify dt/2 on the fine grid. Common dt may decrease after pilots.

yplus_policy.check: Record maxima, spatial location and wall-length weighted distribution. Do not block solely because tiny local regions exceed y+=1; assess their impact through mesh convergence.

quality_policy: Audit actual CGNS geometry, all depth bands, in-plane resolution, topology, positive volumes and boundary/physics continuity before launching the flow family.
outputs: Existing results reused; machine-readable logs, checks and GCI data only. No report.
